subject: Site Engineer, Civil Utilities, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Site Engineer, Civil Utilities role in Adelaide, advertised on SEEK. The ad describes an engineer building capability alongside experienced teams on water, sewer and utilities packages, which is the step I'm after.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020: project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, then field engineer on subdivision finishing works, where I did inspections, quality checks, procurement and materials tracking, and site, material and progress reports. In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, covering road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design to Australian Standards, with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019).

I have no water or sewer experience yet and I haven't used InEight, Aconex or Procore, so those would be new. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, available for site work, and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Glad to talk any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Cadet Building Certifier / Engineering Graduate, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Cadet Building Certifier / Engineering Graduate role advertised on SEEK. The ad is written for a recent engineering graduate or someone early in their career who wants a path into building certification.

My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), covering structural principles and construction methods, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, working to Australian Standards in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked the work against them, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, which is the inspection and compliance side of certification.

I have not worked with the National Construction Code yet and my Australian experience is study, so I would be learning the codes and your processes from the start. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to the Sunshine Coast.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the cadet pathway.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
